app.note: prebuilt release APK with a local mock login; the app is signed in and resting on the Dashboard before every run

tasks.title: Read two values on the first screen
tasks.prompt: In the app, find the Total Savings amount and the monthly amount of the 'House Savings Plan' on the Dashboard.

tasks.title: Navigate to a tab and read a value
tasks.prompt: Open the Explore tab and find the interest rate (p.a.) of the Fixed Deposit product.

tasks.title: Open a form and read a dropdown
tasks.prompt: Open Create Savings, open the Product Type dropdown, and list every option shown with its percentage. Do not save or submit anything.
